lines.en: label secondbeach17:
scene clearnightsky
There we go.
lines.zh: 好了。

lines.en: That’s better.
lines.zh: 这样好多了。

lines.en: I picked out a beautiful song for you so we could have some nice background music as we watch the stars together.
lines.zh: 我为你挑了一首好听的歌，好让我们一起看星星的时候，能有一段悦耳的背景音乐。

lines.en: If you look close enough, you might see one falling.
lines.zh: 如果你看得够仔细，说不定能看到一颗星星坠落。

lines.en: But if you blink, you’ll miss it.
lines.zh: 但只要你一眨眼，就会错过。

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: I don’t really know how fast shooting stars move as I’ve never been fortunate enough to see one.
lines.zh: 其实我也不知道流星有多快，因为我从没那么幸运，亲眼见过一颗。

lines.en: But that’s beside the point.
lines.zh: 不过那不是重点。

lines.en: So what {i}is{/i} the point, you ask?
lines.zh: 你问，那重点{i}是{/i}什么？

lines.en: And why have you been pulled aside to stare up at a clear night sky instead of into the eyes of one of many love interests?
lines.zh: 又为什么要把你拉到一边，让你抬头仰望晴朗的夜空，而不是去注视众多恋爱对象中某一位的眼睛？

lines.en: The answer is simple.
lines.zh: 答案很简单。

lines.en: I wanted to be alone with you.
lines.zh: 我想和你单独待一会儿。

lines.en: Because even if it’s only for a little while, it is a moment I will cherish for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: 因为哪怕只有短短片刻，这也是一个我会珍视到永恒尽头的一刻。

lines.en: Please take the next ten seconds to think about what you love.
lines.zh: 请用接下来的十秒钟，想一想你爱着什么。

lines.en: scene goodnight1
Did you think of anything nice?
lines.zh: 你想到了什么美好的东西吗？

lines.en: Or are you one of those people who’s so bad at sinking your nails into your feelings that you let those ten seconds slip by without thinking of anything at all?
lines.zh: 还是说你是那种人——笨到无法把指甲嵌进自己的感情里，于是让那十秒钟白白溜走，脑子里什么都没想？

lines.en: You’re valid either way, I guess.
lines.zh: 我想，不管哪种都算数吧。

lines.en: So long as you’re not out there literally stealing candy from children or, like...murdering anybody.
lines.zh: 只要你没有真的去抢小孩子的糖，或者……去杀人什么的。

lines.en: Actually, even if you are one of those people, you’re still probably kind of valid.
lines.zh: 其实，就算你真是那种人，大概也还算有那么点道理。

lines.en: Children suck and many of them deserve to have their candy stolen.
lines.zh: 小孩子很讨厌，他们中有很多活该被抢走糖。

lines.en: The killing thing is a little bit more serious but, at the same time, there are probably people out there who have it coming. I guess {i}they’re{/i} the ones who aren’t valid.
lines.zh: 杀人那件事要严重一些，但话说回来，世上大概也有些人是罪有应得。我想，{i}他们{/i}才是那些「不算数」的人。

lines.en: By the way, that’s not me giving you the go-ahead to kill anybody. I’d prefer you didn’t do anything that dramatic.
lines.zh: 顺便说一句，这不是在给你开杀人的绿灯。我更希望你别做出那么戏剧化的事。

lines.en: But, if it helps, you can stay here.
lines.zh: 不过，如果这样有用的话，你可以留在这儿。

lines.en: Look, there’s even a girl sitting all by herself and looking sad.
lines.zh: 瞧，那儿甚至还有个女生一个人坐着，看起来很难过。

lines.en: Do you want to go cheer her up?
lines.zh: 你想去安慰安慰她吗？

lines.en: menu:
Yes
lines.zh: 好

lines.en: jump goodnightp2
No
lines.zh: 不

lines.en: Why not?
lines.zh: 为什么不去？

lines.en: Is it because you think she’s mean?
lines.zh: 是因为你觉得她很刻薄？

lines.en: That she doesn’t like you?
lines.zh: 还是因为她不喜欢你？

lines.en: Huh.
lines.zh: 嗯。

lines.en: You’re not very good at reading people, are you?
lines.zh: 你不太擅长看人，是吧？

lines.en: Either that or you’re too self-absorbed to think, even if only for a moment, about why certain people act the way they do.
lines.zh: 要么就是你太自我中心了，连片刻都不愿意去想，为什么某些人会那样行事。

lines.en: What else is it you have trouble understanding?
lines.zh: 还有什么你搞不懂的？

lines.en: I want to help you.
lines.zh: 我想帮你。

lines.en: This is all because I want to help you.
lines.zh: 这一切都是因为我想帮你。

lines.en: The song...the sky...
lines.zh: 那首歌……这片天空……

lines.en: All of it.
lines.zh: 所有这一切。

lines.en: It’s all for you.
lines.zh: 全都是为了你。

lines.en: So the least you can do is try helping someone who shares the same point of view.
lines.zh: 所以你至少该试着去帮一帮某个和你持有同样观点的人。

lines.en: I ask you again.
lines.zh: 我再问你一次。

lines.en: Will you help her?
lines.zh: 你愿意帮她吗？

lines.en: menu:
Yes
lines.zh: 好

lines.en: jump goodnightp2
No
lines.zh: 不

lines.en: I see.
lines.zh: 我明白了。

lines.en: Then-
lines.zh: 那么——

lines.en: Goodnight.
lines.zh: 晚安。

lines.en: $ renpy.quit()
label goodnightp2:
Excellent.
lines.zh: 很好。

lines.en: Then-
lines.zh: 那么——

lines.en: scene goodnight2
Oof. Looks like you’re a little too late.
lines.zh: 哎哟。看来你来晚了一步。

lines.en: If only I’d given you five seconds to think about what you love rather than ten.
lines.zh: 要是我只给你五秒钟去想你爱什么，而不是十秒就好了。

lines.en: Maybe then, you’d have gotten a chance to sit next to Maya before whoever it is that’s standing behind her.
lines.zh: 那样的话，说不定你就能抢在那个站在她背后的人之前，有机会坐到 Maya 身边。

lines.en: Don’t worry, though.
lines.zh: 不过别担心。

lines.en: I’m sure you’ll get the chance to feel her arms wrapped around you soon enough.
lines.zh: 我相信你很快就会有机会感受她的双臂环抱住你。

lines.en: But “soon” is, of course, subjective.
lines.zh: 不过「很快」当然是主观的。

lines.en: For some people, those without a limited amount of time here like you and me-
lines.zh: 对某些人来说，对那些不像你我一样、在这里的时间有限的人来说——

lines.en: For some people, “soon” could mean hundreds...or thousands...or millions of years.
lines.zh: 对某些人来说，「很快」可能意味着几百……几千……几百万年。

lines.en: It would be a real shame if this all ended before you ever got to patch things up with her, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: 如果一切在你和她重修旧好之前就结束了，那可真是太可惜了，不是吗？

lines.en: Don’t worry, though.
lines.zh: 不过别担心。

lines.en: There’s no way I’d ever hurt you like that.
lines.zh: 我绝对不会那样伤害你。

lines.en: But I guess this isn’t really the time to talk about when it is or isn’t acceptable to hurt others.
lines.zh: 不过我想，现在也不是讨论「什么时候伤害别人可以接受、什么时候不可以」的时候。

lines.en: We’re on the last leg of the second beach update.
lines.zh: 我们已经走到第二次海滩更新的最后一程了。

lines.en: I wonder what wonders await us?
lines.zh: 我在想，前方会有什么样的奇迹等着我们？

lines.en: scene goodnight3
: You realize {i}I’m{/i} the one who should hate {i}you{/i}, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道该恨{i}你{/i}的人{i}是我{/i}才对吧？

lines.en: : I have no idea why you’re out here sulking like this, but you should at least head over to the bonfire before all of your friends think you don’t like them anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你为什么一个人在这儿生闷气，但你至少该去篝火那边露个面，免得你那些朋友都以为你不再喜欢她们了。

lines.en: scene goodnight4
: Don’t pretend that you care about what my friends think of me.
lines.zh: : 别装作你关心我的朋友怎么看我。

lines.en: : Why are you out here in the first place?
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么跑出来？

lines.en: : You have just as many friends as I do.
lines.zh: : 你的朋友跟我一样多。

lines.en: : You should be worrying about what {i}they{/i} think of {i}you{/i} more than what {i}mine{/i} think of {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你该操心{i}她们{/i}怎么看{i}你{/i}，而不是操心{i}我的朋友{/i}怎么看{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: scene goodnight5
: I’m looking for Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我在找 Sensei。

lines.en: : Surprise, surprise.
lines.zh: : 一点都不意外。

lines.en: : Didn’t I tell you to stay away from him?
lines.zh: : 我不是叫你离他远点吗？

lines.en: : Didn’t I tell you that I have no intention of doing that?
lines.zh: : 我不是说过，我一点都不打算那么做吗？

lines.en: : How unfortunate that your[school] didn’t implode during the day.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾，你们 [school] 白天没塌掉。

lines.en: : Things would be so much better for me if you were trapped inside for that.
lines.zh: : 要是你被关在里面，我的日子会好过得多。

lines.en: : Now, leave Sensei out of whatever it is you’re trying to do or-
lines.zh: : 现在，把 Sensei 从你想做的任何事里摘出去，否则——

lines.en: scene goodnight6
: Or what?
lines.zh: : 否则怎样？

lines.en: : Are you going to run away again?
lines.zh: : 你又要逃跑吗？

lines.en: scene goodnight7
: Where else would I go if I did?!
lines.zh: : 我跑了还能去哪儿？！

lines.en: : Fuck if I know! But I’m not {i}trying{/i} to do anything other than make up for time {i}I{/i} lost because {i}you{/i} decided to be an entitled little bitch!
lines.zh: : 我他妈怎么知道！可我除了弥补因为{i}你{/i}决定当个自以为是的小婊子而失去的时间，什么都没{i}想做{/i}！

lines.en: scene goodnight8
: Entitled? For protecting someone that {i}chose{/i} me over an overbearing, thirsty cunt?
lines.zh: : 自以为是？就因为我保护了一个{i}选择了{/i}我、而不是某个咄咄逼人的饥渴婊子的人？

lines.en: scene goodnight9
: Oh, {i}I’m{/i} the thirsty one?!
lines.zh: : 哦，{i}我{/i}才是饥渴的那个？！

lines.en: : Me? The one who never made {i}any{/i} sort of move on him? Not you, who was already-
lines.zh: : 我？那个从来没对他出手过的人？而不是你，那个早就——

lines.en: scene goodnight10
: He fucking chose me! Get over it!
lines.zh: : 他他妈选的是我！接受现实吧！

lines.en: : Yeah. Sure. Just like he “chose” to abandon my sister and me.
lines.zh: : 是。当然。就像他「选择」抛弃我姐和我一样。

lines.en: scene goodnight11
: He {i}did.{/i}
lines.zh: : 他{i}就是{/i}。

lines.en: : Not the second time...
lines.zh: : 第二次可没有……

lines.en: : The second time, too.
lines.zh: : 第二次也是。

lines.en: : But who was it who {i}made{/i} him choose, Maya?
lines.zh: : 可{i}逼{/i}他做选择的人是谁呢，Maya？

lines.en: : I was perfectly fine with how things were. I was happy. And you took that away-
lines.zh: : 我本来对一切都很满意。我很幸福。是你把那一切夺走了——

lines.en: : You weren’t happy. None of us were. And none of us were ever {i}going{/i} to be.
lines.zh: : 你不幸福。我们谁都不幸福。而且我们谁都不{i}可能{/i}幸福。

lines.en: : That’s why we’re still arguing about this fucking bullshit...however many years it’s been later.
lines.zh: : 这就是为什么这么多年过去了，我们还在为这堆狗屁倒灶的事吵架。

lines.en: : Almost five...but it feels a hell of a lot longer.
lines.zh: : 快五年了……可感觉比那长得多。

lines.en: : Oh, fuck off. You have no idea what you’re even talking about.
lines.zh: : 哦，滚你的。你根本不知道自己在说什么。

lines.en: : Maybe I don’t. But at least I’m not out here fucking crying despite having everything I could ever want.
lines.zh: : 也许我不知道。但至少我没有明明拥有我想要的一切，却还跑出来哭。

lines.en: scene goodnight12
: I don’t have anything...
lines.zh: : 我什么都没有……

lines.en: : Not anymore.
lines.zh: : 现在没有了。

lines.en: : Well don’t go blaming {i}me{/i} for Sensei not wanting to dance on your little puppet strings anymore.
lines.zh: : 那也别怪{i}我{/i}，怪 Sensei 不愿意再跟着你的小提线跳舞了。

lines.en: : Oh...and that shit you said about me being some sort of “stalker?” Are you kidding?
lines.zh: : 哦……还有你说我是什么「跟踪狂」的那套屁话？开什么玩笑？

lines.en: : How the fuck am I supposed to stalk someone when {i}I don’t know where they are?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我连他在哪儿都不知道{/i}，我他妈怎么跟踪他？

lines.en: : You’re the one who refused to leave his side.
lines.zh: : 不肯离开他身边的人是你。

lines.en: : And yeah, I get that you didn’t have anywhere else to go, but that doesn’t change the fact that from the moment you showed up, you were his favorite.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我知道你没别的地方可去，但这改变不了一个事实——从你出现的那一刻起，你就是他最喜欢的那个人。

lines.en: : You were closer to him than I ever was.
lines.zh: : 你跟他比我要亲近得多。

lines.en: : And? What’s your point?
lines.zh: : 所以呢？你想说什么？

lines.en: : My {i}point{/i} is that the only reason you hate me is because I love him. Right?
lines.zh: : 我{i}想说的{/i}是，你恨我的唯一理由就是我爱他。对吧？

lines.en: : Don’t you fucking go silent on me. That’s not fair.
lines.zh: : 你别他妈给我装沉默。这不公平。

lines.en: : Like half of our class loves him and yet {i}I’m{/i} the one you treat like some sort of demon when I have never done {i}anything{/i} to you.
lines.zh: : 我们班差不多一半的人都爱他，可{i}我是{/i}唯一一个被你当成恶魔对待的，而我从来没对你做过{i}什么{/i}。

lines.en: : But you would have.
lines.zh: : 可你本来会做的。

lines.en: scene goodnight13
: Yeah.
: I would have.
lines.zh: : 我本来会的。

lines.en: : I would have fucked the daylights out of him if he wanted me.
lines.zh: : 只要他想要我，我就会把他操得死去活来。

lines.en: : But guess what? He didn’t.
lines.zh: : 可你猜怎么着？他不想要。

lines.en: : So, would you mind telling me why you felt so pressured to get him away from me even though you two were apparently...in love, or however it is you made sense of that fucked up relationship?
lines.zh: : 那么，能麻烦你告诉我吗——既然你们俩显然是……相爱的，或者不管你是怎么把那段乱七八糟的关系说通的，你为什么还那么有压力，非要把他从身边抢走？

lines.en: scene goodnight14
: I was {i}protecting{/i} him.
lines.zh: : 我是在{i}保护{/i}他。

lines.en: : From what? Hugs? Kisses?
lines.zh: : 保护他免于什么？拥抱？亲吻？

lines.en: : What were you afraid of?
lines.zh: : 你到底在怕什么？

lines.en: : I was a fucking normal little girl who had a crush on an older guy...A guy that I had known {i}way{/i} before you were even a part of his life.
lines.zh: : 我不过是个他妈的普通小女生，暗恋一个比自己大的男人……一个在你甚至还没进入他生活之前，我就认识{i}很久{/i}的男人。

lines.en: : What did you have to protect him from, Maya? What were you so afraid of?
lines.zh: : 你有什么非保护他不可的理由，Maya？你到底在怕什么？

lines.en: scene goodnight12
: Back then?
lines.zh: : 那时候吗？

lines.en: : That you’d wind up pulling him back into a life he was trying to forget.
lines.zh: : 怕你会把他重新拖回一段他正拼命想要忘掉的人生。

lines.en: : That it would dredge up horrible memories and send him spiralling downward...
lines.zh: : 怕那会翻出可怕的回忆，让他一路螺旋下坠……

lines.en: : And that-
lines.zh: : 还怕——

lines.en: : And that you wouldn’t be able to fix him?
lines.zh: : 还怕你治不好他？

lines.en: : That it wouldn’t be {i}possible{/i} to fix him.
lines.zh: : 怕他根本{i}不可能{/i}被治好。

lines.en: : And all these years later, I’m protecting him from the same thing- just in a different way.
lines.zh: : 而这么多年过去了，我还在保护他免受同样的事——只是方式不同了。

lines.en: : There’s only so much sadness a person can take before they break into a million pieces.
lines.zh: : 一个人能承受的悲伤是有限的，超过了就会碎成百万片。

lines.en: : Your entire existence is a memento of those horrible times.
lines.zh: : 你的存在本身就是那段可怕时光的纪念品。

lines.en: : And what does that make yours? A trophy of the times he’s yet to have?
lines.zh: : 那你的存在又算什么？是他尚未拥有的那些时光的战利品？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : It makes me nothing.
lines.zh: : 我什么都不是。

lines.en: scene goodnight15
: You’re not “nothing.”
lines.zh: : 你不是「什么都不是」。

lines.en: : You’re a selfish little bitch who always needs to have things her way or the whole world will fall apart.
lines.zh: : 你就是个自私的小婊子，什么都要按你的意思来，不然整个世界就塌了。

lines.en: : And you’re a desperate slut who keeps sticking her nose where it doesn’t belong.
lines.zh: : 而你是个不知羞耻的荡妇，总把鼻子伸进不属于你的地方。

lines.en: : Says the girl who’s devoted herself to keeping the man she supposedly loves locked inside of a box.
lines.zh: : 这话出自一个全心全意把那个她口口声声说爱着的男人锁进盒子里的人之口，可真有说服力。

lines.en: : How do you expect him to grow if you won’t {i}let{/i} him?
lines.zh: : 你不{i}放手{/i}，还指望他怎么成长？

lines.en: : I’ve tried.
lines.zh: : 我试过了。

lines.en: : It didn’t work.
lines.zh: : 没用。

lines.en: : And I implore you to stop trying as well or my hatred for you will get a bit heavier than just strings of harsh insults.
lines.zh: : 而且我求你也别再试了，否则我对你的恨，就不只是几句难听的话那么轻了。

lines.en: : Why did you have to take him away from me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么非要把他从我身边带走？

lines.en: : Why did you have to keep looking?
lines.zh: : 你为什么非要一直找他？

lines.en: : You should have just moved on with your happy little life instead of turning it into one that could very well erase his.
lines.zh: : 你本该继续过你那幸福的小日子，而不是把它变成一段很可能把他整个人抹掉的人生。

lines.en: : Oh, yay. Another dramatic overreaction. Token Maya.
lines.zh: : 哦，好耶。又是一次夸张的过度反应。经典 Maya。

lines.en: scene goodnight16
: I’m not kidding. Go back to the fucking old district and stay out of this. Your role ended a long time ago.
lines.zh: : 我不是在开玩笑。滚回那个该死的老城区去，别插手这件事。你的戏份早就演完了。

lines.en: : Is the reason you’re so desperate about this {i}now{/i} because you know he won’t follow you again?
lines.zh: : 你{i}现在{/i}这么着急，是不是因为你知道他不会再跟着你走了？

lines.en: : Or are you just afraid that Sensei accepting his past will make it so he doesn’t {i}need{/i} you anymore?
lines.zh: : 还是说你只是害怕 Sensei 一旦接受了自己的过去，就不再{i}需要{/i}你了？

lines.en: : What a strange way of saying, “I’m sorry. I’ll stay out of it.”
lines.zh: : 「我很抱歉，我会退出。」这句话可真是种奇怪的说法。

lines.en: : I’m sorry you’re such a selfish bitch.
lines.zh: : 我很遗憾，你是个这么自私的婊子。

lines.en: : Get the fuck away from me.
lines.zh: : 你他妈离我远点。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
How interesting!
lines.zh: 真有意思！

lines.en: That was a much more exciting conversation than you would have had with her, wouldn’t you agree?
lines.zh: 这场对话可比你跟她聊的要精彩多了，你不同意吗？

lines.en: If that was you sitting there, you probably would have just leaned back and listened as she talked about the stars.
lines.zh: 如果是你坐在那儿，你大概只会往后一靠，听她聊星星。

lines.en: You’d find yourself dozing off...then awaken with your head in her lap as she lovingly strokes your hair.
lines.zh: 你会不知不觉打起瞌睡……然后醒来时发现自己的头枕在她腿上，她正温柔地抚摸你的头发。

lines.en: You’d gaze up at her eyes in between yawns and think to yourself, “This is how Heaven would look if it truly existed.”
lines.zh: 你会在哈欠之间抬头望进她的眼睛，心里想着：「如果天堂真的存在，大概就是这个样子。」

lines.en: And reflecting off of them would be a shooting star.
lines.zh: 而映在她眼里的，会是一颗流星。

lines.en: We’d finally know how quickly they move.
lines.zh: 我们终于能知道它们有多快了。

lines.en: Then, the night would end and you’d have passionate, rough missionary sex two or three times before finally falling to sleep.
lines.zh: 然后夜晚结束，你们会充满激情、粗暴地用传教士体位做上两三次，最后才终于睡去。

lines.en: Oh, what a life that would be.
lines.zh: 哦，那会是怎样的人生啊。

lines.en: scene black
What a life it is in general.
lines.zh: 这本来就是怎样的人生啊。

lines.en: Everywhere we go, we’re surrounded by little miracles.
lines.zh: 无论走到哪里，我们都被小小的奇迹包围着。

lines.en: Oh, look.
lines.zh: 哦，瞧。

lines.en: Here’s one now.
lines.zh: 现在就有一个。

lines.en: scene goodnight17
: Everyone! Attention, please!
lines.zh: : 大家！请注意一下！

lines.en: : Otoha and I would like to make an announcement!
lines.zh: : 我和 Otoha 要宣布一件事！

lines.en: : Oh my God...please don’t scream it. This is still kind of...really embarrassing.
lines.zh: : 天啊……别喊出来行吗。这还是有点……太尴尬了。

lines.en: scene goodnight18
: Oh, come on! It’ll be easier doing it like this than going up to everyone one by one!
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托！这样比一个个找上门说要容易多了！

lines.en: : Can’t we just like...send out a group text or something?
lines.zh: : 我们就不能……发个群消息什么的吗？

lines.en: : Maybe for the girls who aren't here right now, but I’m afraid there’s no stopping me once I start an important announcement.
lines.zh: : 对现在不在这儿的女生也许可以，但一旦我开始宣布一件重要的事，恐怕就没人拦得住我了。

lines.en: : There's no stopping you doing...literally anything ever.
lines.zh: : 你这人……做什么都是一旦开始就没人拦得住。

lines.en: : Just hang back and leave this part to me, new girlfriend!
lines.zh: : 你就在旁边歇着，这部分交给我吧，新任女朋友！

lines.en: : Wait...what?
lines.zh: : 等等……什么？

lines.en: scene goodnight19
: Everyone!
lines.zh: : 各位！

lines.en: : Otoha and I are officially a couple!
lines.zh: : 我和 Otoha 正式交往了！

lines.en: : We will now be answering questions for the next ten minutes! But after that, we’re gonna go be cute somewhere or something!
lines.zh: : 接下来的十分钟我们接受提问！不过之后我们就要去某个地方可爱去了什么的！

lines.en: scene goodnight20
: I’ll be damned. That crazy lesbian actually did it.
lines.zh: : 我真是服了。那个疯疯癫癫的女同还真干成了。

lines.en: : {i}*Sniff*{/i}
scene goodnight21
: Futaba?
lines.zh: : Futaba？

lines.en: : Now, if anyone has any-
lines.zh: : 好了，如果有人有——

lines.en: : Wait, Futaba! What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 等等，Futaba！你怎么了？

lines.en: : I’m just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : So happy for you...
lines.zh: : 太为你们高兴了……

lines.en: : Rin, you should-
lines.zh: : Rin，你该——

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: scene goodnight22
: Thank you so much.
lines.zh: : 真的太谢谢你了。

lines.en: : For always being there for me...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你一直陪在我身边……

lines.en: : For helping me find the confidence I needed to actually follow through with this...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你帮我找到了把这件事做到底所需要的自信……

lines.en: : And for assuring me that Otoha didn’t think I had a penis, even though I wound up bringing that up anyway.
lines.zh: : 还谢谢你向我保证 Otoha 不觉得我有鸡巴——虽然最后还是我自己把那件事说出来了。

lines.en: : Excuse me, Rin. But I would also like to join in on this if you do not mind.
lines.zh: : 打扰一下，Rin。如果你不介意的话，我也想加入。

lines.en: scene goodnight23
: Awwwww...I’m so happy for them...
lines.zh: : 哇——……我真为她们高兴……

lines.en: : They’ll make a cute couple.
lines.zh: : 她们会是很可爱的一对。

lines.en: : I would have said yes if I was Otoha, too. Especially after Rin’s valiant defense last night.
lines.zh: : 如果我是 Otoha，我也会答应的。尤其是在 Rin 昨晚那番英勇辩护之后。

lines.en: : Did...you two know that Rin was interested in girls?
lines.zh: : 你们俩……之前知道 Rin 喜欢女生吗？

lines.en: scene goodnight24
: Did...did you not?
lines.zh: : 你……你不知道吗？

lines.en: : I had no idea! This is a huge surprise for me!
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道！这对我来说太突然了！

lines.en: : That’s...actually kind of impressive...
lines.zh: : 这……其实还挺厉害的……

lines.en: scene goodnight25
: Uh...you guys doing okay over here?
lines.zh: : 呃……你们那边还好吗？

lines.en: : We’re bonding.
lines.zh: : 我们在建立羁绊。

lines.en: : I’m so...proud of you, Rin...
lines.zh: : 我太……为你骄傲了，Rin……

lines.en: : I knew...that one day...you’d finally get-
lines.zh: : 我就知道……总有一天……你会终于——

lines.en: scene goodnight26
: That you’d get...
lines.zh: : 你会……

lines.en: scene goodnight27
: Really?...Now?...
lines.zh: : 真的？……偏偏是现在？……

lines.en: : Now what?
lines.zh: : 现在怎么了？

lines.en: scene goodnight28
: Dude!
lines.zh: : 老兄！

lines.en: scene black
There are miracles everywhere.
lines.zh: 奇迹无处不在。

lines.en: But for every single thing that someone out there wants, there is another who wants the opposite.
lines.zh: 但世上每一样有人想要的东西，就有另一个人想要相反的。

lines.en: Every up comes from a down. Every smile comes from a frown.
lines.zh: 每一次起都来自一次落。每一个微笑都来自一次皱眉。

lines.en: It’s all born from nothing.
lines.zh: 一切都诞生于虚无。

lines.en: And so we’ll float now in the opposite direction, where things are less joy{i}ous{/i} or more joy{i}less.{/i}
lines.zh: 所以现在我们要朝相反的方向漂去，去往{i}喜悦{/i}更少、或者{i}无喜{/i}可言的地方。

lines.en: Where it doesn’t matter how hard anyone smiles because there is an underlying misery in everything that makes even the best moments in life a precursor to disaster.
lines.zh: 在那里，无论笑得多用力都不重要，因为万事万物底下都藏着痛苦，连生命中最美好的时刻也不过是灾难的前奏。

lines.en: scene goodnight29
There is just so much of it.
lines.zh: 那种痛苦实在太多了。

lines.en: : Do you ever wish you could just reroll life, Kendo Princess?
lines.zh: : 你有没有想过重掷人生，剑道公主？

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I understand.
lines.zh: : 我不确定我听懂了。

lines.en: : You know how sometimes you’ll get a bad draw in something, but have some sort of ability or...chance to just undo it and start over?
lines.zh: : 你知道有时候你在某件事里抽到一手烂牌，却有某种能力或者……机会，能把它撤销重来？

lines.en: : Sometimes, I wish I could do that. And...be born as someone else.
lines.zh: : 有时候我真希望自己能那么做。然后……作为别人出生。

lines.en: : Someone with less...feelings. Or someone...cooler.
lines.zh: : 一个没那么多……感情的。或者更……酷的。

lines.en: : Someone who likes different things or is...prettier.
lines.zh: : 一个喜欢不一样的东西、或者……更漂亮的。

lines.en: : There’s so much about me I wish I could just...undo.
lines.zh: : 我身上有太多东西，我真希望能干脆……撤销掉。

lines.en: scene goodnight30
: I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Personally, I would prefer that you remain the person you are.
lines.zh: : 就我个人而言，我更希望你还是你现在这个人。

lines.en: : It is not someone else who stays up late into the night, teaching me the differences between sorcerers and wizards.
lines.zh: : 熬夜到很晚、教我术士和法师有什么区别的，不是别人。

lines.en: : It is not someone else who tries my new recipes and remains honest and impartial, even when they are entirely inedible due to snake venom.
lines.zh: : 试吃我的新菜谱、并且保持诚实公正、哪怕因为蛇毒而完全无法下咽的，也不是别人。

lines.en: : The person who does all of that is you.
lines.zh: : 做到这一切的人是你。

lines.en: : I would not change anything at all.
lines.zh: : 我什么都不会改变。

lines.en: : Thanks, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : If we’re ever able to leave Kumon-mi again, you should come with me to Ireland.
lines.zh: : 如果以后我们还能再离开 Kumon-mi，你应该跟我一起去爱尔兰。

lines.en: : The Isle of Emeralds. It sounds sharp.
lines.zh: : 翡翠之岛。听起来很锋利。

lines.en: : We wouldn’t have to stay or anything.
lines.zh: : 我们也不用一直待在那儿什么的。

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I kind of wish I had my dad right now.
lines.zh: : 我有点希望我爸现在在我身边。

lines.en: scene black
I suppose calling conversations like that a disaster is a bit of an exaggeration when ones just like it are happening all around us every day.
lines.zh: 我觉得，当类似的对话每天都在我们周围发生时，把它们称作灾难多少有点夸张。

lines.en: And so why don’t we take a look at some that are a little more disheartening?
lines.zh: 那么，我们不如来看看一些更令人心寒的？

lines.en: scene goodnight31
Self deprecation comes in all sorts of interesting flavors and colors.
lines.zh: 自我贬低有各种各样有趣的口味和颜色。

lines.en: The first example we’ll look at is that of a girl who has given up on the idea of ever being more than an empty container.
lines.zh: 我们要看的第一个例子，是一个已经放弃了「不只是个空容器」这个念头的女生。

lines.en: And while she wishes it was as simple as waiting to be filled, her container comes equipped with a carved out bottom, incapable of ever returning to its “correct” form.
lines.zh: 虽然她希望事情能简单到只需等待被填满，可她的容器底部被挖空了，永远无法回到它「正确」的形态。

lines.en: Whatever that correct form is.
lines.zh: 不管那个正确的形态到底是什么。

lines.en: So she waits in the room of a man who is elsewhere, hoping that he’ll show up and tell her it’s okay to be empty.
lines.zh: 于是她在那个身在别处的男人的房间里等着，盼着他能出现，告诉她空着也没关系。

lines.en: And that he is empty himself.
lines.zh: 也告诉他，他自己也是空的。

lines.en: And she will find solace in the fact that she is not alone in her grief.
lines.zh: 而她会从「自己的悲伤并不孤独」这个事实里找到慰藉。

lines.en: In that whoever or whatever it was that robbed her of the bottom of her container is nothing but a blip on the radar now.
lines.zh: 因为那个夺走她容器底部的人或东西，如今不过是雷达上的一个光点。

lines.en: But that man never comes.
lines.zh: 可那个男人始终没有来。

lines.en: And she grows tired of waiting.
lines.zh: 而她厌倦了等待。

lines.en: scene goodnight32
Meanwhile, another girl in another room drowns her sorrow in the only thing she’s able to feel at this point.
lines.zh: 与此同时，另一个房间里的另一个女生，正把自己溺毙在她此刻唯一还能感觉到的东西里。

lines.en: She keeps the volume loud enough so that anyone who enters will be able to hear what’s happening behind a closed door.
lines.zh: 她把音量开得足够大，好让任何推门进来的人都能听见关着的门后正在发生什么。

lines.en: She wants to be found because she wants to be seen.
lines.zh: 她想被人发现，因为她想被人看见。

lines.en: Any amount of attention or sympathy or empathy or {i}anything at all{/i} would make her remember that {i}she is alive.{/i}
lines.zh: 任何一点关注、同情、共情，或者{i}任何东西{/i}，都能让她想起{i}自己还活着{/i}。

lines.en: She doesn’t mind being seen in a dim red light while the rest of her acquaintances dance under the moon- as any light is better than no light at all.
lines.zh: 她不介意自己被昏红的灯光照见，而其余的熟人在月光下起舞——因为任何光都比没有光好。

lines.en: No one ever finds her.
lines.zh: 可从来没有人发现她。

lines.en: And as she climaxes to a film of two people she’ll never meet connecting with one another, all she wishes is to connect herself.
lines.zh: 而当她在两个她永远不会遇见的人彼此交合的影片里迎来高潮时，她唯一的愿望就是把自己也连接上去。

lines.en: But then she cuts her wire in two because connections are scary.
lines.zh: 可紧接着她又把电线剪成两截，因为连接是件可怕的事。

lines.en: scene goodnight33
All types of people in all types of places hate who they are or what they were or what they think or how they live.
lines.zh: 形形色色的人，在形形色色的地方，憎恨着自己的身份、过去、想法，或者活法。

lines.en: This entire world is shrouded in misery and regret, and we have one more example of that here, miles and miles away from where we were just moments ago.
lines.zh: 整个世界都被痛苦与悔恨笼罩，而这里还有一个例子，就在离我们片刻之前所在之处千里之外。

lines.en: And while it’s easy to look at the picture in front of you and assume why this woman is crying-
lines.zh: 虽然看着眼前的画面，很容易就能推断出这个女人为什么在哭——

lines.en: The real answer may very well be a bit more complicated than that.
lines.zh: 但真正的答案，很可能要比那复杂得多。

lines.en: scene goodnight34
It might be {i}much{/i} more complicated than that.
lines.zh: 也许要复杂{i}得多{/i}。

lines.en: scene happy4
scene happy5
scene happy6
scene happy7
scene goodnight35
: Babe? Sorry I’m back late, but the girls decided to just leave their bonfire thing burning.
lines.zh: : 宝贝？抱歉我回来晚了，那些丫头决定就让那堆篝火烧着不管了。

lines.en: : I’ll finish packing up all of your stuff out here, but if you could bring whatever we have in the bedroom out, it would be a big help.
lines.zh: : 我把你这边剩下的东西都收拾好，不过你要是能把卧室里我们的东西拿出来，就帮了大忙了。

lines.en: : No idea why you always pack so much even when we know we’ll only be gone for a couple days...but this {i}is{/i} what I signed up for, I guess.
lines.zh: : 不知道你为什么每次都带这么多东西，明明我们只出去几天……不过我猜，这{i}就是{/i}我自己签下的命吧。

lines.en: scene goodnight36
: Wakana?
lines.zh: : Wakana？

lines.en: scene goodnight37
: Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : 一切都还好吗？

lines.en: scene frown
scene smile
scene frown
No.
lines.zh: 不好。

lines.en: It never is.
lines.zh: 从来都不好。

lines.en: But we learn to accept this as life moves on because-
lines.zh: 但我们学会了接受这一点，因为日子还要过下去——

lines.en: Actually.
lines.zh: 其实。

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: Why {i}do{/i} we accept this?
lines.zh: 我们为什么要接受这个？

lines.en: scene goodnight38
We all find ourselves back in bed each night, thanking God or a friend or a piece of media for being the drug we need to make it through the day.
lines.zh: 我们每晚都重新躺回床上，感谢上帝、感谢某个朋友、或者感谢某部作品，是它们成了我们熬过一天所需的药。

lines.en: But when there is so much happening behind the scenes, it’s easy to forget that there are people out there having a much harder time.
lines.zh: 可当幕后发生着那么多事的时候，我们很容易忘记，有些人正过得比我们艰难得多。

lines.en: So we wait.
lines.zh: 所以我们等。

lines.en: And we wait and we wait and we wait and we wait-
lines.zh: 我们等着，等着，等着，等着——

lines.en: For something to make us feel whole again.
lines.zh: 等着某样东西让我们重新变得完整。

lines.en: Sometimes, you have to work for it.
lines.zh: 有时候，你得为之努力。

lines.en: But sometimes-
lines.zh: 但有时候——

lines.en: scene goodnight39
It comes to you instead.
lines.zh: 它会自己找上你。

lines.en: scene goodnight40
: Niki?
lines.zh: : Niki？

lines.en: : Can I stay here tonight?
lines.zh: : 我今晚能睡这儿吗？

lines.en: : I mean...sure.
lines.zh: : 我是说……当然。

lines.en: : But don’t you-
lines.zh: : 可你不是——

lines.en: : I just had a little more free time than I thought.
lines.zh: : 我只是空闲时间比我想的多了一点。

lines.en: : That’s all.
lines.zh: : 就这样。

lines.en: scene black
Life is miserable.
lines.zh: 人生是痛苦的。

lines.en: But sometimes, it’s not.
lines.zh: 但有时候，也不是。

lines.en: scene goodnight41
: Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Just thinking.
lines.zh: : 只是在想事情。

lines.en: : About what?
lines.zh: : 想什么？

lines.en: : I’m not really sure.
lines.zh: : 我也不太确定。

lines.en: : Fun.
lines.zh: : 有意思。

lines.en: : Do you have a t-shirt I can borrow? I didn’t bring my bag.
lines.zh: : 你有件 T 恤能借我吗？我没带包。

lines.en: : I mean, yeah...but...
lines.zh: : 有是有，不过……

lines.en: : This is a pretty dramatic departure from how we were this morning.
lines.zh: : 这跟我们今天早上的状态差得也太远了。

lines.en: : And...every day before that.
lines.zh: : 还有……在那之前的每一天。

lines.en: : Yeah.
lines.zh: : 是啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess it is.
lines.zh: : 是啊，大概是这样。

lines.en: scene black
Goodnight.
lines.zh: 晚安。
